newsitem.title: THAILAND: TelecomAsia expects overall profit in 1997.
newsitem.headline: TelecomAsia expects overall profit in 1997.

text.p: Thai telecom firm TelecomAsia Plc will post unconsolidated profits over the course of 1997, vice-chairman Vallobh Vimolvanich said on Friday.
"It will definitely be positive over the course of 1997 as the burden for TA is reduced," Vallobh told Reuters.
The firm has been burdened with higher-than-expected costs of installing 2.6 million fixed lines in 1996 to meet changed contract terms. The project is now complete.
"We knew 1996 and 1997 would be a difficult period for the company but it is something we have anticipated...I think we are over the worst and we can expect a turnaround next year," Vallobh said.

On Thursday, he told Reuters the turnaround for the company would come after the second half of next year after its loss-making UTV cable television provider and programme-making subsidiary came out of the red.
